def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape[0] == logp_call_only.shape[0] == logp_no_call.shape[0]):
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must have same number of rows (candidates)")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape[1] == logp_call_only.shape[1] == logp_no_call.shape[1]):
        raise ValueError("Input arrays must have same future horizon length")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)  # shape (future_horizon,)

    # Compute weighted future-token losses (T02)
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Filtering (T04)
    margin = L_minus - loss_with_result
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margin
